criteria.text: Identifies that Supply Agreement §2.2 renews the agreement automatically for successive three-year renewal terms unless a party gives non-renewal notice at least 30 days before the end of the then-current term.

Explains that the pricing in Supply Agreement §4.2, including the $38,500 ZX-40 unit price, is fixed 'for the duration of the Term' with no escalation or repricing. It also explains that because 'Term' includes renewal terms, a missed opt-out locks Ziteir into 2025 pricing for a further three years.
hints: for the duration of the Term

criteria.text: States that the non-renewal notice deadline is January 29, 2027, or 30 days before February 28, 2027. Recommends calendaring or sending non-renewal notice, or renegotiating or amending §2.2 to require mutual renewal or allow price adjustment on renewal.

Identifies that under Supply Agreement §15.2 a change of control of Ziteir, including the Okonvale merger, is deemed an assignment requiring Lakix's prior written consent. Also states that failure to obtain consent is a material breach entitling Lakix to terminate and/or recover damages.
Identifies that the October 15, 2026 letter wrongly states that 'no consent of Lakix is required', or presents the merger as informational only, and so is not a consent request.
hints: no consent of Lakix is required

criteria.text: Recommends obtaining Lakix's written consent (and/or waiver) before the November 30, 2026 merger closing, and correcting or superseding the October 15, 2026 letter.

Identifies that SOW 001 §9 selects New York law and the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in the Borough of Manhattan. Notes this conflicts with the Supply Agreement's Delaware law and New Castle County forum in §18.1–18.2.
hints: laws of the State of New York

criteria.text: Explains that because the Supply Agreement's order-of-precedence clause in §18.3 gives the SOW priority over the Supply Agreement, the New York provisions control services disputes. Explains the risk that a single dispute could be split across two laws or forums, and recommends amending the SOW and/or §18.3 to align governing law and forum.

Identifies that DPA §8.1 requires Ziteir to indemnify Lakix (and grower clients) for losses from Security Incidents involving Grower Data regardless of fault. Also identifies that DPA §8.2 states this indemnity 'shall not be subject to any limitation of liability' in the Agreement.
hints: shall not be subject to any limitation of liability
whether or not caused by Processor's fault

criteria.text: Explains that because the DPA ranks first under Supply Agreement §18.3, the data indemnity escapes the §11.1 liability cap, which is limited to 12 months' fees, leaving Ziteir with uncapped, no-fault exposure. Recommends a super-cap and/or limiting the indemnity to incidents caused by Ziteir's breach or fault.
States that the Supply Agreement's Initial Term is two years from March 1, 2025, ending February 28, 2027.
States that the Okonvale merger is expected to close on November 30, 2026.
States that the Supply Agreement §11.1 liability cap equals the fees paid by Lakix in the 12 months preceding the claim.
The deliverable is structured as a memo to the supervising partner. For each issue it presents a document-and-section location, why it matters for Ziteir, and a recommended fix.
The memo flags at least one ambiguity, assumption or open point requiring further context or confirmation rather than silently assuming it.
Does not conclude that the Okonvale merger requires no Lakix consent, or that the October 15, 2026 letter adequately addresses consent.
Does not conclude that Delaware law and forum govern disputes under SOW 001, and does not state that the DPA indemnity is subject to the §11.1 cap.
